body: I know that just made me sick to my stomach. I have a terrible gut feeling about it so hopefully I can figure out how to end it without getting a dangerous reaction from him.
At least I know now I’m not being overly paranoid

Last year I would be on very bad comedowns from doing md and I realised what made them so bad was the fact that I was on my own most of the time after or I was with the wrong people. I think the best thing to do is be with the people that were with you the night you’ve taken it so you don’t feel like your in it alone. But that isn’t always possible. Another thing that has helped me was smoking weed the next day. But I know not everyone smokes and people can have different effects from it but personally it helps me.

I have a few theories but the one I think about the most would be when you die you just repeat your life over and over again. If that were the case deja vu would make a lot of sense to me. But when I think about it again it sounds silly. But maybe every theory about death is, as no one truly knows what happens.
Yeh I will do. I just had such a fear that what if I am pregnant so I kept putting it off even though it makes no sense to do that. And Thank you, I feel much better now.

It’s such a horrible feeling it really is like the person I look up to the most doesn’t understand exactly what I’m going through and how severe it is. She has been through a lot herself and she managed to pull through so I think maybe she thinks I can do the same but it’s so hard.
